seed: Shannon Byrne Susko, CULTURAL: Team Core Values Discovery, and Discovering or Confirming your Team Core Values with your Whole Leadership Team (adapted from Jim Collins’ Mission to Mars), Metronomics. Byron Darlison, Values: How Not To Chase Your Tail (darlison.com).

slides.title: Run Mission to Mars with your team before the next session.
slides.headline: Run Mission to Mars with your team before the next session.
slides.support: Each leader runs the five steps with their own team.
body: Bring your team’s top three values to the next session, with the behaviour behind each.
notes: The values come from the whole company, not only the leadership team. Then the language belongs to everyone.
A company that already has Core Values runs the same exercise to confirm them.
Homework: each leader runs Mission to Mars with their team and brings the results to the next session.
